articles.title: Blow for Netanyahu as opposition rival asked to form government by Israel's president
articles.summary: Israel's president has asked Benjamin Netanyahu's strongest rival, Gadi Eisenkot, to try and form a government following a deadlocked election.

articles.title: At least 27 people killed in strike near Yemen's capital, Houthi official says
articles.summary: At least 27 people have been killed and 36 others wounded, mostly women and children, after airstrikes hit homes in a village near Yemen's capital, Sanaa, a spokesman for Yemen's Houthi-run health ministry said.

articles.title: No clear winner after New Zealand general election
articles.summary: The New Zealand election count has ended without a definitive result as the two main parties remain almost deadlocked in the popular vote.

articles.title: Thousands turn out to greet Pope Leo as he begins Latin America tour
articles.summary: Thousands of people greeted Pope Leo as he arrived in Uruguay at the start of a 12-day tour of Latin America.

articles.title: Meghan's father in court charged with possessing child abuse material
articles.summary: The Duchess of Sussex's father has appeared in court after being arrested and charged with allegedly possessing child sexual abuse images.

articles.title: UK has 'new pair of eyes' in space as new military satellite enters orbit
articles.summary: The UK has a "new pair of eyes" in space after it launched a new military satellite into orbit, the Ministry of Defence (MoD) has announced.

articles.title: Boy, 6, dies in hospital after house fire that killed four members of his family
articles.summary: A six-year-old who sustained critical injuries during a house fire that killed four members of his family has also died, police said.

articles.title: Two dead after bus carrying schoolchildren crashes in France, officials say
articles.summary: A seven-year-old girl and an 18-year-old boy have been killed after a bus crashed in eastern France, French authorities said.
